name: Chintamani Fragment
effect: Once each turn, you may reveal the top card of the shared relic/event deck. You may leave it on top or place it on the bottom.
note: Closed City relic. Keeps the prototype ratio at 3 relics and 4 events per side.

name: Reactor Core Fragment
effect: Your Specialist and Mystic each gain +1 ATK. When one of them takes Leak damage, it gains +1 RANGE on its next AP ability this turn.
note: Closed City relic for Elena/Zoya pressure and visible stat tracking.

name: Karpova's Black Key
effect: Your Leader and Common each gain +1 MOVE. Once each turn, one of them may move through 1 placed object or allied occupied tile, but must end on an empty tile.
note: Closed City relic for access and movement.

name: Signal Array Turns
effect: The active player's first ranged attack or ranged AP ability this turn gains +1 RANGE if the acting character is adjacent to a placed object or Leak marker.

name: Reactor Prayer
effect: Choose one of your characters. It takes 1 damage, then its next attack or AP ability this turn gains +1 ATK or +1 RANGE.

name: Closed City Incident
effect: Place 2 Leak markers on different empty tiles within 2 of the center tile.

name: Seventeen Seconds
effect: The active player's first movement action this turn may move through 1 occupied tile, placed object, or Leak marker, but must end on an empty tile.

name: The Emerald Tablet
effect: Once each turn, after one of your characters gains Memory or starts movement adjacent to a placed object, choose one allied character within 2 tiles of a placed object. It gains Shield or +1 RANGE on its next AP ability this turn.
note: Flood Survivors relic. Keeps the prototype ratio at 3 relics and 4 events per side.

name: The Black Sarcophagus
effect: Your Warrior and Hero each gain +1 maximum HP. Once each round, when an enemy adjacent to one of your placed objects attacks, Mark that enemy after the attack resolves.

name: Tide-Sealed Archive
effect: Your Leader and Specialist each gain +1 RANGE on AP abilities. Once each turn, when an ally gains Memory, you may move that ally 1 tile. It must end on an empty tile.

name: The Causeway Breathes
effect: Place 1 allied Stone marker on an empty tile within 2 of the center tile. The active player's first movement action this turn may move through 1 placed object without taking effects from that object, but must end on an empty tile.

name: Black Water Remembers
effect: Choose 1 allied character adjacent to a placed object. That character gains 1 Memory marker, max 1 per character. Then move that character 1 tile. It must end on an empty tile.

name: The Flood Reaches The Walls
effect: Each character on an outer edge tile becomes Marked until the end of the round.

name: The Drowned Seraph Speaks
effect: Choose your Mystic. Until the start of your next turn, the first enemy that damages your Mystic becomes Marked after the attack resolves. If your Mystic is Thalassa-Nekh, she also gains Shield.
